user.title: Timed Scenes
user.description: Add Timed Scenes? You can then add a Timed Scene card to any dashboard.

set.name: Set a timed scene
set.description: Creates or replaces a timed scene. Returns {ok, errors} or {ok, id, start, end}.

id.name: Scene ID
id.description: Identifier of the scene (lowercase letters, digits and _).

end.name: End
end.description: End date and time (ignored when a duration is given).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Duration of the scene (takes precedence over end).

entities.name: Entities
entities.description: Ordered list of {entity, start_value, end_mode (value | previous | none), end_value}.

delete.name: Delete a timed scene
delete.description: Deletes a timed scene. If it is running, its entities are restored immediately.
